title: wg: protocol-06 §5.2 no userStatus for 'every client's key material exhausted'
description: protocol-06 §5.2 L1163-1172, L1279-1300: success = material for every client; partialSuccess = for at least one; noCompatibleMaterial = none could supply material compatible with requiredCapabilities. A user whose clients all report keyMaterialExhausted fits none of these exactly. mimid reads noCompatibleMaterial as 'no client succeeded, list may be populated' (decision mimid-1wgh.5.63); Haven sends partialSuccess (see haven bead under mimid-1wgh.46.1). Suggested fix: say which userStatus applies when no client succeeds for a reason other than capabilities, or add one.
